t: Reusable Command self-adhesive strips designed for indoor use. Suitable for use on a range of surfaces including painted walls, painted wood, glass, tiles, and other smooth, solid or hollow surfaces. These strips hold securely and remove cleanly for easy repositioning, and leave no cracks, holes, damaged plaster or sticky residue behind. Easy to use with no need for tools or nails. Ideal for rented homes or spaces where surface damage is a concern. Can be used as refill strips with Command general purpose hooks. Pack contains 8 small, 4 medium, and 4 large strips.
